gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gantari: Bellota Text strides in with open, unshaded curves and a confident, one-of-a-kind look. Gantari follows in wire-bent lines with wide apertures, and that easygoing friendliness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gayathri: Gayathri reads soft and open-ended, its curves carrying the faint thick-thin of a letterpress slug. Bellota Text, by comparison, is blunt and sturdy, with crossbars as heavy as its stems, so the two feel like a loud voice beside a gentle one.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-google-sans: Bellota Text opens with bold, distinctive letters whose curves are free of any calligraphic shading. Google Sans then settles in with uniform strokes and terminals pulled well back, and that friendly modern restraint is what makes the pair stick.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-google-sans-flex: Those open, unshaded curves give Bellota Text a commanding presence that no pen-drawn contrast could match here. Google Sans Flex works well a size or two smaller.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable, first of all, thanks to Gothic A1 and its splayed c terminal. Bellota Text is the louder partner, with round letters as heavy as its straight ones, and that weight against a low-key body is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gotu: Clean and modern describes Gotu, with sturdy hairlines and e crossbars that open their mouths. Gotu looks best at a slightly larger size, so its slim bowls hold their own beside Bellota Text, whose ballpoint-pen stroke feels more blunt.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gowun-dodum: Unshaded, open curves make Bellota Text instantly recognizable, and they give it real authority. Yet Gowun Dodum brings a smooth, tube-like softness and a wide-mouthed a, which is the quiet strength of this pair.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gruppo: Bellota Text draws its strokes without any variation in thickness, which gives it a bold, no-nonsense presence. But Gruppo is lighter and more delicate, its curve endings never crowding each other, so the page feels both firm and refined.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gudea: Punchy and open, Bellota Text lands with unshaded curves that grab attention at once. Gudea takes over with thread-thin, steady curves and glass-clear gaps at the terminals, so a long passage feels friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-hanken-grotesk: Bellota Text leads with commanding, open curves and no calligraphic shading anywhere in sight. And Hanken Grotesk carries a longer read well, its wire-bent lines and wide channels into each counter keeping the text clean and easy to follow.
